## 👨‍🔬 Biography

**Xavier Clemente García Cevallos** is a biologist and research student specializing in **computational drug discovery**. His work bridges experimental science and computational methods, with a focus on the discovery and characterization of bioactive molecules from natural sources.

::: callout-note
## 🎯 Research interests

- 💊 **Computational drug discovery**
- 🧪 **Cheminformatics**
- 🧬 **Bioinformatics**
- 🌿 **Natural products**
- 🧠 **Neurobiology**
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🔬 Research Approach

His research integrates **experimental phytochemistry** with ***in silico*** approaches, including:

| Approach | Application |
|-------------------------------|----------------------------------------|
| ⚛️ **Molecular docking** | Prediction of ligand–target interactions |
| 💧 **ADMET profiling** | Evaluation of pharmacokinetic and toxicity properties |
| 🌀 **Molecular dynamics** | Study of molecular behavior and stability |
| 💻 **Software development** | Reproducible computational workflows |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🚀 Featured Project

::: callout-tip
## ADMETShiny

Xavier is the developer of **ADMETShiny**, an **open-source R package** designed to facilitate the analysis and visualization of **molecular descriptors** and **ADMET properties**.

👉 [View on GitHub](https://github.com/xavierclementegarcia/ADMETShiny){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
